name: GraveBound: The Black Tapes
source:
When a disgraced detective traces an investigative reporter's brutal death to a series of cursed VHS tapes, he must find the origin before he becomes the entity's next victim.

[From [url=https://lunatic-wolf-games.itch.io/gravebound]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当一名声名扫地的侦探追查一位调查记者惨遭虐杀的案件，并将线索锁定在一系列受诅咒的VHS录像带上时，他必须在自己沦为那个邪祟的下一个猎物之前查明一切的源头。

[摘自[url=https://lunatic-wolf-games.itch.io/gravebound]itch.io[/url]]
